bullets.text: Game Pass Ultimate Launch - **Call of Duty: Black Ops 7** will be available on launch day for Game Pass Ultimate subscribers.
Security Commitment Report - **Microsoft's** November 2025 SFI Progress Report highlights significant investments in security innovations.
AI-Powered Security Insights - **Microsoft Security Copilot** uses generative AI to enhance security operations and incident response.
Sovereign Cloud Enhancements - **Microsoft** expands its Sovereign Cloud capabilities to meet regulatory demands and customer needs.
AI in Healthcare Workflows - **Azure AI Foundry** and **UiPath** streamline healthcare processes, improving efficiency and patient care.
Recognition in Application Streaming - **Microsoft** named a Leader in IDC MarketScape for application streaming and enterprise browsers.
New Insider Preview Builds - **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build 28000 introduces improvements for users in the Canary Channel.
